ctx.x: And her first name? George Henry. George Anna Wright, I thought, see. And then the Begards and the Pirones are on, and I can't keep it all straight. Well, no,

I told you that was going to be complicated. The Begards are on the McKenna side. Bonnie's mother was my grandmother's sister. There were five sisters and about four or five brothers. So, after the sisters married, you have the Marqueses that come in there. That's another sister. So, it would take us two, three months to sit down here and go through each individual's married life and their offspring. But that's how Bonnie and I are cousins because my grandmother and his mother were sisters. And Bonnie was born, I…
know Emil, his father? Emil, the girl?
